comparison.objective: Commission a rigid industrial damper versus unwrap a flexible tether from a post and park its collar.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine tool use and force-limited adjustment versus deformable routing around an obstacle.
comparison.success_condition: Safe repeated stops and stable locked setting versus tether unwrapped and collar in a marked circle. No numeric tether rubric is provided.
comparison.reason: The record tests topology-changing deformable manipulation; the candidate tests rigid mechanism adjustment and dynamic response.
